name: plan-daily-7
description: daily7 (the owner's name, 2026-09-27: cheap API seats, and the expensive Opus 5.5 seat runs on a local Claude Code session). Tiered council for planning ONE feature cheaply (Muad, 2026-09-27: "Opus 5.5 on a local sub that does the important tasks from the highest7 setup ... all together ~1$ per council run"). Same stages and flags as plan-highest-7 (alternatives, debate, decision records, deep dive, majority guard ON, canary, dispute, handoff); only the seats and the deep-dive cap differ. ANCHOR SEATS write the whole alternative architectures (seats.alternatives), answer the posts on them, and are the only panel that votes, unanimously (seats.critics): Claude Opus 5.5 on the owner's Claude subscription (provider external, model subscription:opus-5.5, lab opus5.5-sub: $0 API, a separate Opus 5.5 Claude Code session answers its paused stages), GPT-6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Pro through OpenRouter. MASS SEATS (seats.proposers, seven labs from the strong and low-cost part of arena.ai's agent leaderboard, fetched 2026-09-27): Tencent Hy4 preview, Gemini 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.2, Muse Spark 1.3, Qwen 3.8 Max, Mistral Medium 3.5 (kept on the owner's word) write the blind proposals and every debate post and reply, and post on the anchors' architectures (alternatives.debaters "all"); they argue, they never vote. DEEP-DIVE SEAT: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, a mass-tier model (a different model from the voting V4 Pro, so chain-lint deep-dive-votes passes), under its own $0.50 cap: a feature-sized task is one 40,000-character call, and a $4 sub-cap would be larger than this chain's whole worst case. Criteria: Llama 4 Maverick, which holds no other seat. WRITER SEATS (skeleton, build, deep-dive-revise, revise-N, dispute, handoff) are a Claude Code session running Sonnet 5, which builds and holds no panel seat. The Opus 5.5 panel seat is a DIFFERENT Anthropic model in a separate session: the owner's plan-highest-7 exception (an Anthropic model reviews a draft another Claude writes), not selfReview - no model writes and votes. ROUTING, because a NEEDS file names only its label: every label containing opus5.5-sub goes to the Opus 5.5 session (alternative-, alt-debate-, alt-reply-, panel-N-, including the suffixed forms panel-N-opus5.5-sub-retry, -reask1, -reask2 and alternative-opus5.5-sub-retry); skeleton, build, deep-dive-revise, revise-N, dispute and handoff go to the Sonnet 5 session. Nothing checks who wrote an answer. Dry run on a one-page feature task (2026-09-27, GPT-6 Luna in place of GPT-6 Sol on the owner's word: "GPT 6 Sol is too expensive, take GPT 6 luna"): $1.90 worst case at 7 rounds; under the default $7 cap. No Kimi, no xAI. Run once with real models (2026-09-28); none of its mechanisms has been measured. Price your task with `npm run dry` and get an explicit go before any paid run.
